title: Build report lines with a Stream.Builder

blocks.text: `Stream.builder()` gives a mutable `Stream.Builder<T>`: `add` elements one at a time, under whatever conditions you like, then call `build()` once to get the stream. After `build()` the builder accepts nothing more.

Write `ReportLines.lines(List<String> items, boolean header, boolean footer)`; a `Stream.Builder<String>` suits it. The result starts with `"HEADER"` if `header` is true, then holds the items in their order, repeats included, each trimmed of surrounding spaces (spaces inside an item stay), and ends with `"FOOTER"` if `footer` is true. Items that are `null` or blank are left out.
Items are ASCII text, so the only whitespace they carry is ASCII. The items come from user input: expect stray spaces, blank entries and the odd `null`.

cases.says: It puts the header first when asked, then the items in order, then the footer when asked.
An item that is blank, only spaces, is left out.
Each item is added trimmed of its surrounding spaces.
A null item is left out instead of throwing NullPointerException.

concepts: Elements added one by one under conditions are trimmed first and kept only when present and not blank.
